votes.motion: Approve the Work Session Meeting Minutes of January 18, 2022 as well as the Formal Meeting Minutes of February 15, 2022.
votes.description: Approval of two sets of prior meeting minutes: the January 18, 2022 work session minutes and the February 15, 2022 formal meeting minutes.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing, suspend the rules, and adopt Resolution 5 of 2022 to authorize the waiver of lease fees for the use of the Art Barn by the Salt Lake City Arts Council Foundation.
votes.description: Authorizes the waiver of lease fees for the Salt Lake City Arts Council Foundation's use of the Art Barn at 54 Finch Lane as administrative headquarters and gallery space.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 6 of 2022: Budget Amendment No. 6 for Fiscal Year 2021-22 including the employment staffing document only for items as shown on the motion sheet (partial adoption). (1st Action – Motion 1)
votes.description: Partially adopts Budget Amendment No. 6 for FY2021-22, approving selected items from the motion sheet including the employment staffing document, while leaving other items for separate votes.

votes.motion: Approve item A-9 as part of Ordinance 6 of 2022: Budget Amendment No. 6 for Fiscal Year 2021-22 to create three new Arts Council full time positions. (4th Action)
votes.description: Amends Budget Amendment No. 6 to fund and create three new full-time positions for the Arts Council.

votes.motion: Adopt Item A-7 as part of Ordinance 6 of 2022: Budget Amendment No. 6 for FY 2021-22 to provide funding for a City fireworks event. (2nd Action)
votes.description: Would have approved funding for a City fireworks event as part of Budget Amendment No. 6; failed due to concerns over drought conditions, fire safety, and air quality.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 7 of 2022: Rezone and Master Plan Amendment for the Former Fire Station No. 3 Property.
votes.description: Rezones properties at 1085–1097 East Simpson Avenue and 1104 East Sugarmont Drive from PL to CSHBD1 and amends the Sugar House Community Plan Future Land Use Map to consolidate the parcels for future development by the Redevelopment Agency.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 8 of 2022: Rezone at 1193 West California Avenue.
votes.description: Rezones the property at 1193 West California Avenue from R-1/7,000 to R-1/5,000 to allow the owner to subdivide and construct two new homes, potentially with ADUs.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 9 of 2022: Rezone at 2060 North 2200 West.
votes.description: Rezones the property at 2060 North 2200 West from AG-2 (Agricultural) to M-1 (Light Manufacturing) to implement master plan zoning and accommodate future commercial land uses.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 10 of 2022: Assessment for the Central Business Improvement Area – 22 (CBIA-22).
votes.description: Confirms the equalized assessment list and levies an assessment against certain downtown properties to finance economic promotion activities in the Central Business Improvement Area over the next three years.

votes.motion: Adopt the Consent Agenda (as amended to remove Item G1 – Special Event Permits of Less than 31 Days).
votes.description: Approves the consent agenda including setting public hearing dates and approving board appointments and reappointments, with Item G1 removed per a friendly amendment from Council Member Mano.
